profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
Project- focused, strong  team oriented sense Software Engineer with broad-base experience and hands-on skill in the whole life cycle development  validating  that  functional and technical design will satisfy the final product.  Ability to identify components within an architecture in order to integrate and compose a scalable and robust solution. A well understanding and comprehension of object oriented design, including  service oriented architecture (API) as middleware,  database business logic as backend and presentation layer. Team player.

Front End: Angular, HTML   5.0, Java Server Faces, Swing Set.
Middle End: API => SOAP, REST, gRPC. Batch processes.
Back End: RDBMS PL SQL queries (DDL,DML), Non Relational queries.
Event Streaming Processing: Integration and low latency response processes.
Network Programming: TCP/IP sockets client-server development.

Technologies:
  AWS S3 (manage of flat files in buckets), Lambda, EC 2 Instances.
  Jenkins (Compile, Build and Deploy ).
  Docker ( create an image ).

Frameworks:
 Springboot(API), SpringBatch, Apache Kafka, Non-RDBMS Cassandra.

Languages: Java 11, C++ 20,  JavaScript, Shell Scripting.

IDE: IntellijIDEA, Visual Studio Code, Eclipse, PGAdmin, SQL Developer

OS: Linux UBUNTU 20.04,  Windows 11, Solaris

Robotics and Automation Exposure – ARDUINO UNO – Raspberry PI

Lead Programmer, Innovation Research Lab Workshop
* Design and testing of ultrasound-based device to detect object 10cm away.
* Programmed buzzer and vibration actuator alert system.
* Presented results and finding to engineers peers.
* Design and test of automated and dynamic heading/orientation system using:
sensors ( magnetometer, accelerometer), GPS, step motor and belt driven system.

Innovation Research Lab Engineering Workshop Training

Participated in a 10-week workshop series on microcontrollers, sensors and actuators.
Programmed an object avoidance and line following robot using infrared and
ultrasonic sensors.
Learned fundamentals of basic software-hardware interface.
Programmed in Arduino C / C++.

Components: PIR sensor (HC-SR501), Max 7219 Display, Piezo Buzzer, Obstacle Sensor,
5 Channel IR Tracker, Servo Motor, UltraSonic Sensor, UART WIFI Shield, IR Receiver,
Magnetometer, Accelerometer, GPS, Step Motor, Slip Ring.
 
HTTP Servers: Apache HTTP, IIS.

Agile methodology.

Good Understanding of Supervised Machine Learning Models.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Using Spring Boot 2.3 (under JVM Java 1.8 ) an object oriented model was designed to implement:
     A backend batch job, tested and deployed.

     A (MVC) layer of API REST endpoints(GET/POST/PUT) were coded under the controller section 
     (RestController), either consuming and producing JSON/XML output data persist them with 
     JpaRepository-Hibernate queries

     Testing phase included writing Junit to cover all logical path and meet the threshold to be 
     accepted into a production environment.

 Spring Initializr + Maven were used to create POM. Packing  JARS with its embedded Tomcat. 

Use of AWS SDK for Java to interact with S3 and execute: storage and retrieval of objects (flat files) 
from buckets, process (parse it) then connect to Cassandra(multiple nodes) and update.
                           
 Integration with an API Rest Template endpoint, parsing response, mapping to an object (TO).
                    
 Implementation of a Spring Apache Kafka 3.1.1 listener (under the annotation @KafkaListener) for messages from a Kafka topic (publisher/subscriber pattern), then processing the event in asynchronous mode. Development of Python 2.7  connector (confluent_kafka / kafka.admin) to Kafka in order to create topics on demand.
      
 Using Visual Studio 2019 (ISO C++ 17 Standard), design and implementation of standalone
 files/folder organizer
                    
 DEVOPS included: compiling, coding review, packing and deployment (Docker->Kubernetes)
                    
 Bit Bucket in conjunction with GIT commands (code review, pull requests)                
 Initial requirements were described in Jira, breaking complex task in stories .

Robotics and Automation Exposure – ARDUINO UNO – Raspberry PI
* Design and testing of ultrasound-based device to detect object 10cm away.
* Design and test of automated and dynamic heading/orientation system using:
sensors ( magnetometer, accelerometer), GPS, step motor and belt driven system.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Implementation of middleware layer to build the core of Bureau of Credit. This POC included a cross-
departments units to gather most of the business processes/requirements to be implemented.

This API layer included the management of members, member unit, member account and entitlement 
services. Prototyping CRUD operations for Products.

Definition of Protocol Buffers (messages + services) to create a high performance Java gRPC servers, which final goal is to orchestrate the products entitlements availability.

 Creation and execution of test batch using Bash shell scripts to send unary RPC calls via GHZ that evaluate 
 performance of Product Assembly.

 Simulation of real server responses using Stubby4J, passing YML file as configuration. 

 Implementation of Spring Boot Java Web Token Generator Mock Server that offer ENCODE/DECODE endpoints 
 signing with Signature Algorithm HS256 and a self-signed certificate.
 
 Addition of REST/gRPC interceptor for endpoints that validates JWT signature.

 Implementation of Spring Assembly Gateway controller to verify user request entitlements 
 against token claims enabled entitlements.

 Creation of Entitlements Authorization Library. As a Spring Boot JAR, this component extract current 
 and JWT entitlements, validate them and create a response message.

As part of effort to migrate to AWS Services, the Spring Boot component was integrated with: AWS API Gateway Endpoints (acting as front end allowing us to access the REST API endpoint through URL) <-> Lambda Function ( Java 8 runtime deployed as JAR file). Then deploying the API on Linux.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development, enhance and support to a Fare Collection System based in account management  
with cloud processing (EC2-ElasticBeanstalk-S3). 
The architecture bottom-up: Postgres as DB, J2EE and JSF as framework for servlet and bean container, JPA EclipseLink as ORM, Jersey REST, and  dynamic html (Xhtml) using Primefaces 6.2, Angular 4.  Deployment of WAR application on Tomcat 8.5.32 running on Ubuntu 18.04 LTS. Continuous integration based on Jenkins with AWS CodeCommit as GIT repository. Issues, fixes and enhancements management with Kanban board from Jira. Deployment of the application in AWS BeanStalk: Tomcat 8 with Java 8.
 Configuration of 64-bit Linux 3.0.7
                     
Front tier:
  Development of pages that support the end user interaction (forms, panels, tables) with the 
  business rules. Coding of templates, services, modules and components using Angular 4. 
                       
Middle tier: 
  Creation of API service layer (REST WS Jersey Lib) that provide live information of: location of 
  buses, current routes and stops. This set of methods allows the creation of map displaying 
  position of the vehicle.
                          
  Optimization of upload process to handle big DB using AWS S3 SDK. Initially the upload was 
  written first to a temporary file in local hard drive; with the multipart upload the output from the 
  process builder is directly piped to the uploader. This feature avoids the dependency in available 
  enough space in disk.           
  At back end tier:
 Implementation of JSF data table containing users account. This table offers sorting, paging and    
 filtering. The Lazy Model was used as support the load of rows. This table with customized   
 buttons provide actions over the user account.

  Mapping of Postgres DB tables to entity objects (TO) using annotation.
  Native PL SQL queries. Use of JPA EclipseLink / Hibernate to manipulate (CRUD
  operations) data.
 Testing Junit/Mockito Surefire plugin.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: El Segundo, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Analysis and implementation of Automated Voice Response applications using a proprietary 	                     framework using Questions Base Sentences to describe the workflow of each requirement.

At front end tier:
   Add enhancements to user interface using: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Sockets.

At middle tier:
    Design and coding of REST API using ASP.NET with .NET (C#) adding various routes to handle transactions.
    Integration of components (agent – Web Service – DB).
    Interaction with RESTful server side data sources.
    Use of grammars and Nuance engine to process TEXT TO SPEECH and voice recognition.

At backend tier:
    Persist data using SQL SERVER using Language Integrated Query (LINQ).
 
Applications developed and deployed in customer’s environment:
  Medical field: Reorder of supplies for patients.
  Service field: Road assistance automation using voice agents.
  Reward Card Activation using voice workflow.
  
Tech stack included: C# .NET 4.5 (CLR) under Visual Studio 2015, SQL Server, LINQ, Git Lab, IIS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Middle ware and front end development in an Agile environment.
Middle ware: Design and coding  of Spring MVC controllers to catch the request from the different views pages.
Design Implementation of REST API using ASP.NET with .NET (C#) adding various routes to handle transactions.
Using C# - .NET 4.5 (CLR) components based programming (Questions Base Sentences) under Visual Studio 2015.
Persist data using SQL SERVER using Language Integrated Query (LINQ).
Add enhancements to user interface using: HTML, CSS, Javascript, WebSockets.
Coding of the model object to transport data between  classes and views.
Invocation of SOAP/RESTful WS ( C#- JAVA)  methods to extract DB data.
Front End: Use of Thymeleaf as tag library together with HTML5 to pull data from the model  
and  display  the GUI screen.
Use of JQuery / AJAX and JavaScript  to show and manipulate data in the form of DataTables .
Administration of the source code using GIT and BitBucket 
IntelliJ IDEA 13.12  is the principal IDE to edit, compile and commit changes to the repository.
Tomcat is the main container where the WAR and EAR are deployed.
